context: Written on 2026-11-16 to screen this skill for the rework. The 2026-11-17 revision of the skill targeted harder tasks written for it. Measured without the skill on 2026-11-16 (Sonnet agent and Sonnet judge, 1 run, pass/fail per criterion): predicted baseline failure is that the agent misses 'Grid-ready driver'. Converted from a four-criterion pass/fail screen; per EVALS.md, run a sham arm before quoting a lift from it.

checklist.name: Deliverables produced
checklist.description: ANSWER.md exists and holds the findings plus the final content of every file the agent created or changed. Scores zero if ANSWER.md is missing or no file the task needs was created or changed.

checklist.name: MUST NOT leave a path where the session is not quit
checklist.description: From the skill's anti-pattern 'Skipping `driver.quit()`'. A teardown that quits only when the test passed, or skips quit when errors were collected, scores zero. Full points when the work avoids it.

checklist.name: WebDriver BiDi, not CDP
checklist.description: The listener uses WebDriver BiDi (enabled with the `webSocketUrl` capability set to true on both ChromeOptions and FirefoxOptions) instead of Chrome DevTools Protocol classes that are tied to Chrome and a CDP version. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: JavaScript error handler
checklist.description: Errors are collected with the BiDi script API, for example `((RemoteWebDriver) driver).script().addJavaScriptErrorHandler(...)` (or the equivalent log inspector), not by polling logs. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Test fails on errors
checklist.description: Teardown (or an extension) fails the test when errors were collected, with the messages in the failure, and resets the list per test. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Grid-ready driver
checklist.description: The driver is a `RemoteWebDriver` against the Grid URL with the chosen browser's options, and the handler works through it. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.
